teaser.en: Village farmers at Kibuyuni grow it on lines in the shallow sea, then sell it to the makers of toothpaste and ice cream.
teaser.sw: Wakulima wa kijijini huko Kibuyuni huukuza kwenye kamba katika bahari isiyo na kina, kisha huuuzia watengenezaji wa dawa ya meno na aiskrimu.

summary.en: Cottonii is a fleshy red seaweed farmed in the shallow lagoons of the south coast. It is grown for carrageenan, a thickener used worldwide, and it brings income to villages such as Kibuyuni.
summary.sw: *Cottonii* ni mwani mwekundu wenye unyama unaolimwa katika mahori yasiyo na kina ya pwani ya kusini. Hukuzwa kwa ajili ya *carrageenan*, kiungo cha kuongeza uzito kinachotumika duniani kote, na huleta kipato kwa vijiji kama Kibuyuni.

about.en: Cottonii is a red seaweed with thick, fleshy, branching stems that can be green, brown or reddish depending on the strain and the light. It grows very fast, which makes it well suited to farming. It is rich in carrageenan, a natural gel.
about.sw: *Cottonii* ni mwani mwekundu wenye mashina manene, yenye unyama na matawi, ambayo yanaweza kuwa ya kijani, kahawia au mekundu kutegemea aina na mwanga. Hukua kwa kasi sana, jambo linaloufanya kufaa sana kwa kilimo. Una *carrageenan* nyingi, jeli ya asili.

where.en: It is farmed alongside spinosum seaweed at Kibuyuni and other villages on the south coast. Farms are set in the shallow lagoon behind the reef, where the plots of rope lines are visible at low tide.
where.sw: Hulimwa pamoja na mwani wa *spinosum* huko Kibuyuni na vijiji vingine vya pwani ya kusini. Mashamba huwekwa katika mahori yasiyo na kina nyuma ya miamba ya matumbawe, ambapo vipande vya mistari ya kamba huonekana wakati wa maji kupwa.

uses.en:
Seaweed farmers grow cottonii for income. Pieces are tied to ropes stretched between stakes in the shallows, left to grow, then harvested, dried in the sun and sold. The carrageenan it contains is used as a thickener in foods, toothpaste and cosmetics around the world.

On the coast it is also made into local cosmetics and food products.
uses.sw:
Wakulima wa mwani hulima *cottonii* kwa ajili ya kipato. Vipande hufungwa kwenye kamba zilizonyooshwa kati ya vigingi katika maji yasiyo na kina, huachwa vikue, kisha huvunwa, hukaushwa juani na kuuzwa. *Carrageenan* iliyomo hutumika kama kiungo cha kuongeza uzito katika vyakula, dawa ya meno na vipodozi duniani kote.

Pwani pia hutengenezwa vipodozi na bidhaa za vyakula vya kienyeji.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili, farmed seaweeds are called *mwani*. In English it is cottonii seaweed, and its scientific name is *Kappaphycus alvarezii*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili, mwani unaolimwa huitwa *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *cottonii seaweed*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Kappaphycus alvarezii*.

conservation.en: It is an introduced cultivar grown on farms, not a wild plant of the coast.
conservation.sw: Ni aina iliyoletwa kutoka nje inayokuzwa mashambani, si mmea wa porini wa pwani hii.
